mapper.select: select f.*, b.org_id as permission_org_id, b.create_by as permission_create_by from ai_knowledge_folder f join ai_knowledge_base b on b.id = f.knowledge_base_id and b.del_flag = 0 where f.id = #{id} and f.del_flag = 0

with recursive ancestors as ( select id, parent_id, knowledge_base_id from ai_knowledge_folder where id = #{targetId} and del_flag = 0 union select p.id, p.parent_id, p.knowledge_base_id from ai_knowledge_folder p join ancestors a on p.id = a.parent_id and p.knowledge_base_id = a.knowledge_base_id where p.del_flag = 0 ) select count(*) from ancestors where id = #{folderId}
select count(*) from ai_knowledge_folder where parent_id = #{folderId} and del_flag = 0
select count(*) from ai_knowledge_document where folder_id = #{folderId} and del_flag = 0
